articles.title: Inside Zcash's new node that targets Visa-scale privacy at 50,000 transactions per second
articles.snippet: The new Zakura client is the first live piece of a plan to take Zcash from roughly one private transaction per second to payment-network scale.

articles.title: Trump targets Brazil's payments system while dollar stablecoins are quietly overtaking country's payments
articles.snippet: Washington views Brazil’s promotion of non-dollar payment channels, including Pix and the growth of stablecoins, as a potential threat to dollar-based trade, even as dollar-linked stablecoins account for about 90% of Brazil's crypto transactions.

articles.title: Here is why a massive $1.6 billion in crypto liquidity is sitting idle and wasting away
articles.snippet: About $542 million weekly sat outside active trading ranges, meaning this capital earned zero fees and provided no market depth.

articles.title: Japan's SBI Group is building Asia's first cross-border digital asset empire
articles.snippet: The securities giant announced today the consolidation of Singapore-based Coinhako as part of a rapid regional expansion that includes a tokenization partnership with Ondo Finance.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth will erode bank deposits, says ECB’s Cipollone
articles.snippet: ECB’s Piero Cipollone said stablecoin adoption could erode bank deposits, but the digital euro will keep banks at the center of payments.
